note: Every declared runtime dependency, what imports it, and whether Nori still needs it. 'classification' is the owner's vocabulary: required-standard-foundation, external-data, removable-unused, native-replacement, remaining-trained-model.

dependencies.name: @mediapipe/tasks-vision
dependencies.note: Hand/face landmark tracking. Hand tracking is explicitly DEFERRED by owner direction, but this package is genuinely imported today, so it is kept and reported rather than removed.

dependencies.name: cesium
dependencies.note: Globe/map renderer. Supplies terrain and imagery tiles as a DATA SOURCE with attribution; it is not a Nori-created renderer.

dependencies.name: leaflet
dependencies.note: External map information as a data source, attributed. Not Nori-created cartography.

dependencies.name: zod
dependencies.note: Used by the Nori-owned MCP descriptor builder to derive JSON Schema.

dependencies.name: zustand
dependencies.note: Renderer state store. Genuinely imported; confirmed present in package.json and package-lock.json together. Retained deliberately.

removed.name: @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk
removed.reason: Imported only by four preserved bridge adapters (chrome, panels, ui, vision) that the native build already excludes and that bridge/server.mjs never instantiates. Its only used exports were the MCP-shaped tool/server descriptors, which are a published protocol convention, so Nori implemented them itself in bridge/nori-mcp.mjs.
removed.evidence: 23 tools across all four adapters build and validate on the Nori implementation.

removed.name: @anthropic-ai/sdk
removed.reason: Zero import sites in src, bridge, desktop, scripts or tests.

removed.name: @picovoice/porcupine-web
removed.reason: Zero import sites. Wake detection is Nori-authored matching in src/lib/wake.ts over local Whisper output; no Picovoice AccessKey was ever present.

removed.name: @picovoice/web-voice-processor
removed.reason: Zero import sites. The renderer runs its own WebAudio/VAD pipeline in src/lib/vad.ts.
removed.note: Also removed the dead `porcupineKey` field from src/config.ts. It was always the empty string: no Picovoice AccessKey was ever present, and with the package gone the field was a claim about a provider Nori does not use.

removed.name: kokoro-js
removed.reason: Zero import sites. Speech output is the system localService voice (src/config.ts TTS_ENGINE='system') or the Python kokoro_tts.py bridge.

dependencies.name: PyInstaller
dependencies.note: Standard packaging tool for the Core executable.

dependencies.name: websocket-client
dependencies.note: Used only by the preserved legacy Letta adapter, which the native suite does not select.

removed.name: crewai
removed.reason: Declared as a DEFAULT install requirement but never on the native Core path. Its only importers are a lazy fallback in packages/knights/architect/orchestration/task_decomposer.py (reached only when no planner is injected) and the explicit caller-supplied NeoAgent.build_crewai_agent adapter. The live architect is the Nori-native shared/orchestration/architect_worker.py.
removed.note: Moved to nori/requirements-optional-frameworks.txt. It is NOT deleted: the two legacy adapters still import it if a caller explicitly opts in. Removing the default pin is what stops an alternative agent framework being installed by default.
